description: This source file defines the PatientProgramValidator class in the org.openmrs.validator package, which implements validation logic for PatientProgram objects in the OpenMRS system. Its main purpose is to enforce data integrity and business rules for PatientProgram instances, including checks on dates, states, workflows, and duplication prevention.

classes.name: PatientProgramValidator
classes.description: A class that implements the Validator interface to validate PatientProgram objects, ensuring data consistency and business rule compliance when processing patient enrollment and state transitions.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports validation of the given class type, specifically whether it is assignable from PatientProgram.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a PatientProgram object, checking fields like patient, program, enrollment date, completion date, and patient states for logical consistency, date order, duplicate states, overlaps, valid states, and workflow adherence.
